From a bare PDF, the paper adapter extracts each reported number and caps it at “the paper says so”

results.yml
- id: R1
  validates: [C1]
  validation_mode: attest
  evidence: paper.pdf
  reported_value: 0.0011
  locators:
    paper:
      quote: "0.0011"
      page: 1
      section: abstract
claims.yml
- id: C1
  statement: "…a low error rate of
    0.0011 bits per byte in
    converting ABC notation
    to MIDI format."
  validators:
  - id: v1
    kind: attest
    checks: provenance
    inputs: [R1]
  • bGPT paper: 68 results and 2 headline claims; 903 numbers skipped (years, labels, bare integers)
  • Messy tables work: “76.39±0.00” in a table of Loss-Free Machine Unlearning becomes one result, value 76.39
Quotes: Wu et al. 2024, arXiv:2402.19155, CC BY 4.0 · Foster et al. 2024, arXiv:2402.19308, CC BY 4.07 / 16
